title: DETG (DONT END THE GAME)
description: "Don't end the game" A mod that will disable the end portal for 24h and can be editted in the mod's config.
body:
**Overview** 

**DETG** is a simple lightweight **server-side** mod enabling administrators to dynamically lockout access to The End. The mod will initially lockout The End portal for **24-hours** **by default**, however, the amount of time The End is lockedout for is fully **configurable** depending on the speed of your server, by use of the server’s config file. Features Adjustable Lockout: Block access to The End for a specific duration (Default 24-hours). 

Anti-Waste Mechanic: If any player attempts to place Eye of ender into a portal frame while the portal is lockout then The Eye of Ender will **come back to his inventory** as normal. 

Easy To Configure: If you wish to modify The End lockout duration then you are able to do so in the server mod config. Installation Guide First of all download The latest version of this mod. Place the mod into your server's mods file. Now simply Start or Restart your Server to let The mod create The End lockout configuration file for The mod and create a 24-hour lockout for access to The End. 

Why this is better Clear hierarchy The use of headings and bullet points enable owners of a server to scan down the provided information quickly. 

Better phrasing Replacing come back to his inventory and mods file. Explains a key feature The use of anti-waste clearly informs players of exactly what happens when an attempt is made.
